reviews.title: Overcomplicated and Frustrating
reviews.text:
This app overcomplicates what should be a straightforward task, and I completely regret paying for Pro. The interface is cluttered with unnecessary features that make basic navigation frustrating.
All I wanted was a simple tool to take two photos and compare them side by side. Instead, the comparison workflow is unintuitive, and forcing users to manage five separate albums for five specific poses is rigid and annoying. To make matters worse, the AI features barely function..it constantly errors out claiming the background is "too noisy"  or something else. I just don’t see any good use of this app

reviews.title: Used to be free for 1 album but now paid for everything
reviews.text:
The app is fine and used it for about a month when it was free for 1 album until they changed it. Can’t get my old photos anymore oh well. 

The price is too expensive for what it is. Lots of apps that offer free for 1 album and lets you expand later if you decide to pay for it like selfie a day which is a more refined app. Then there is something like Lapsey that does most of what this app does for 1/10 of its price for lifetime access and also free for 1 album. And other body apps that use AI to approximate your measurements as well as keep track of photos 

In order to justify the price, they will need to add more features like AI to approximate measurements.
